test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 17 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one - word substitute for the given group of words.

Poor physical or mental condition.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Ill health**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The term **"Poor physical or mental condition"** refers to a state where an individual's health and well-being are negatively affected, leading to diminished capacity in daily activities. (खराब शारीरिक या मानसिक स्थिति)
 
 
• **Example:** Continuous work stress led him into a state of poor physical and mental condition, affecting his productivity and happiness.
 
 
 
• **"Ill health"** specifically describes a condition of poor health, whether due to illness, injury, or mental condition, and is not merely the absence of disease but a state of reduced physical, emotional, or mental well-being. (खराब स्वास्थ्य)
 
 
• **Example:** After months of battling ill health, she finally began to feel stronger and more energetic.
 
 
 
• Hence, the term that accurately describes "Poor physical or mental condition" is **"Ill health"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Ill health**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Ill nature** (दुर्भावना): Refers to a bad or unpleasant disposition or temperament.
 
 
• **Example:** His ill nature often made collaboration difficult with teammates.
 
 
 
• **Illicit** (अवैध): Refers to something that is not legally permitted or authorized.
 
 
• **Example:** The company was fined for its involvement in illicit activities.
 
 
 
• **Ill-fated** (दुर्भाग्यशाली): Describes something that is destined to fail or have bad outcomes.
 
 
• **Example:** The ill-fated expedition ended in tragedy.
